attributes.action: Require an independent review of AQA's 2026 GCSE English Language results
attributes.additional_details: In 2026, AQA introduced a revised GCSE English Language exam without past papers. Students previously achieving Grades 8-9 received Grade 6, while Grade 6 students received Grades 3-4. Schools reported that comparable marks achieved higher grades under other boards, and examiners raised concerns about inconsistent marking. We call for an independent review of marking and grade boundaries, full marked scripts and detailed mark breakdowns so students can identify errors and challenge results.
attributes.background: Require an independent investigation into AQA's 2026 English Language marking and grade boundaries, ensuring fair and consistent grading, alignment with national standards, and providing every student with their full marked script and detailed feedback.

rejection.details: We can't accept petitions which call for actions with regard to named individuals, organisations or businesses.
